# Who can change an exhibition label

The new label owner is on leave. A misspelled name waits for approval because nobody knows whether the deputy can authorize the correction. Make reversible corrections easy and record them afterwards. [[Maintenance]] should say which decisions can move without the most senior person, while preserving speaker consent for changes of meaning.
